speech.heard: One big country breaks the pattern for how governments fund themselves. It's a total surprise. India, China, or the USA. Only one gets almost nothing from sales taxes. These taxes are collected on the sale, purchase, or delivery of goods and services. The answer is number three, the USA. Its government gets just 2.1% from these taxes. India has 16 times what the USA collects. India gets 32.6%. Guatemala relies on these taxes for 51.9% of its money, over half. Iraq is the world's lowest. It collects only 0.4%. Does your government take a big cut of everything you buy?
